name: A garden with no paths
about: A fenced garden with flowers and a pond, but no way through.

layers.name: Grass and a pond
layers.tip: Start on flat grass. Dig a hole two blocks by two at the back and fill it with water.

layers.name: Fence and flowers
layers.tip: Fence all the way round, with a gate in the front. Plant flowers in the corners.

yourTurn.say: Now add paths, so you can walk round without stepping on the flowers.
ideas: A dirt path. Use a shovel on the grass. Builder tricks has more.
Stepping stones of gravel or stone slabs.
A little bridge over the pond, made of slabs.
A bench to sit on, made of stairs.
